ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Network Connection Initiated By Certutil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a network connection initiated by the certutil.exe utility.
Attackers can abuse the utility in order to download malware or additional payloads.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") AND network_initiated = "true" AND (dest_port = 80 OR dest_port = 135 OR dest_port = 443 OR dest_port = 445))
